My plot is very small, and at my age I keep things simple and low-cost. Here in Mwanza I depend on the rains, and for this intercropped plot I will mostly use seed and inputs that I can manage from home or buy cheaply. I will use some manure if I can get it, but I will not spend much on chemicals or hired work.
